stopped_cart.name: A stopped cart
stopped_cart.text: A grain cart with a broken axle, a Tin Road driver swearing at it in three tongues. He has no writ and no friends here.

options.label: Fix it and share the grain

deed: Kept a Tin Road cart moving

smoke_ridge.name: Smoke on the ridge
smoke_ridge.text: A hamlet burning above the road. Whoever did it is still up there; you can see spears.

deed: Answered the smoke at the ridge

tablet_post.name: A tablet nailed to a post
tablet_post.text: A clay tablet, cracked, nailed up where the road forks. Someone wanted it read.

deed: Read the tablet at the fork

goat_dispute.name: Two men arguing over a goat
goat_dispute.text: Two herders, one goat, one rope. Both of them want the levy to judge it, because the levy carries a writ.

deed: Judged the goat at the road

wandering_smith.name: A smith on the road
wandering_smith.text: A Smiths' guild journeyman with a hand-cart of moulds, going the other way. He will cast, for a price paid later.

options.label: Let him fit whoever needs it

emeritus_levy.name: The old general's levy
emeritus_levy.text: {emeritus}, unseated and bitter, has raised a levy of their own on this road. They want the seat back, or the squad's bronze.

options.label: Give a day and a hearing

emeritus_deal.name: The old holder's offer
emeritus_deal.text: {emeritus} waits at the gate with a proposal: carry a tablet to the scribes that says the seat was taken by writ, not by deed.
